weightedComparability: The proposed180EC comprises82.5EC psychology/neuroscience,37.5EC research/statistics/data/qualitative/review methods,30EC rhetoric/style/persuasion including7.5EC actual primary-school rhetoric teaching,22.5EC sociology/human rights/political philosophy,7.5EC PPD. The youth-resilience project7.5EC adds genuine educational relevance. These contributions support a coherent child-development/language enquiry programme, but do not sustain the defining45EC subject didactics plus5EC classroom-management and33EC sequenced teaching-placement core of PWPO. This judgment concerns academic instructional substance and its weight, not merely the lack of a UCR teaching licence.

candidateAssessment.label: Child development, language & educational inquiry
candidateAssessment.reason: UCR provides strong developmental psychology, psycholinguistics and research methods, together with genuine primary-school rhetoric teaching and a youth-education project. The proposed programme nonetheless centres on psychology, neuroscience and communication. It does not sustain PWPO’s defining breadth of primary-school subject didactics, classroom management and cumulative supervised teaching practice. Adding literary, social or general communication courses does not repair that missing instructional substance. No complete defensible UCR alternative is established; this finding is not based only on professional licensing.
